title: Luxury Modern 2BR A/C Marais - Metro Steps Away
description: Luxury 2-bedroom property in the heart of the Marais, newly refurbished. The master bedroom features a queen-size bed with ensuite shower and toilet. The second bedroom includes a queen-size bed with access to a separate bathroom and dedicated toilet room for privacy. Bright living room with comfortable sofa and large dining table. Fully equipped kitchen for memorable meals. High-speed broadband and Netflix included. Metro station steps away with direct access to all of Paris.

reviews.name: Heather
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time in Paris and loved the location and layout of the apartment. We were travelling with two couples and it was great having separate bedrooms and bathrooms for both couples. The location in Le Marais is perfect as you are close to many restaurants and cute little shops. It’s also walkable to the major attractions and close to Metro seating if you don’t want to / aren’t able to walk any more. This was also a very well equipped AirBnB with anything you need - pots and pans, cups, coffee, pods for dishwasher or washer, etc. which is highly appreciated.

reviews.name: Eric
reviews.text: Loved the apartment, walkable neighbourhood, proximity to Metro. Perfect setup.

reviews.name: Adam
reviews.text: We had a great stay in Marais.  The apartment was exactly as pictured and Fin was very responsive. We loved the neighborhood, which was full of great bakeries and restaurants, centrally located and very walkable.  We also really liked that there was no car traffic right outside the apartment. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.name: Kim
reviews.text: Great location, great acommodations, great communication!  The only issues we had were with the painting happening in the hallway and the wet walls/door.  Due to the painting, the elevator was out so my poor husband had to carry 6 bags up the stairs and back down at the end of our stay.  Also the door to the bathroom at the front of the apartment does not close because it hits a device on the wall. Since we were with family, it didn't bother us, but be aware.  Overall, it was a great.  We found THE YUMMIEST dinner around the corner, lots of ease in walking to cool places like Notre Dame, Sainte-Chapelle. and the Seine.  We even stayed in one night and bought charcuterie and wine nearby and it was just what we needed.  We would definitely stay again!

reviews.name: Ruairidh
reviews.text: Fin's apartment in the Marais was the perfect base for exploring Paris — unbeatable location, right in the heart of the neighborhood and walking distance to great cafés, boulangeries, and the main sights. The place was clean, comfortable, and clearly well thought out, right down to the details. Fin was a fantastic host: communicative, prompt, and full of great local tips. We loved it so much we extended our stay multiple times — we'll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Aleza
reviews.text: Had to pick up keys at a different location then walk to apartment but not too far. Inside the apartment was lovely and had everything we needed. As mentioned, there is construction in the building, so hallways look a mess. Unfortunately, the elevator was out of service during our entire stay. I specifically searched for an apartment with a lift. Carrying our luggage up and down the staircase to the 4th floor was painful. There is a winding staircase and men were working on the stairs for the entire first day, making it quite precarious. This is not Fin’s fault but did make our stay there a little difficult.  He will discount for this reason. The location was fantastic for exploring the city, with so many sites close enough to walk. Metro right outside the building and numerous bus stops all around. Assuming the elevator works, I would definitely stay here again. Fin is a great host and checked on us frequently to see if we needed anything. Great air conditioning!
